correctness.rationale: The local verifier independently rebuilds Q3, all 107 matching simplices, all 4096 induced subcomplexes, and the signed integral boundary maps. It proves no support below eight carries mod-two H2, finds the six perfect-matching-complement supports, verifies an explicit four-step collapse to a connected orientable-free closed surface of Euler characteristic two with cyclic links (hence S2), and verifies all 48 automorphisms act transitively. The integer 44-by-13 matrix formed from 9 third-boundary columns and four two-sphere cycles has rank 13 and all unit Smith factors; as a primitive rank-13 sublattice in the primitive rank-13 kernel of D2, it equals that kernel and proves integral generation and free rank four. All 48 signed Lefschetz traces and irreducible-character orthogonality are checked. Exact finite certificate and standard homology/topology, with no unsupported infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The sharp support threshold and complete six-support classification answer where the top homology of a canonical three-dimensional Cartesian graph first appears under edge-induced restriction. The unimodular certificate proves that these minimal spheres generate the entire integral group, rather than merely spanning rationally; the 48-element group character distinguishes central-inversion parity and an S4 Specht component invisible in the prior homotopy or Betti rank. These combine a motivated local-to-global invariant with a nontrivial symmetry structure, not just a routine re-enumeration of known homology.
